entries.expiry_exact_utc_WHEN_IT_IS_RECORDED_HER: AT DAG NODE N06, STRICTLY BEFORE N10. Clarified by the CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CONSOLIDATED-CLOSURE-AW-R1 lane because the governing authority's own closure_path for this field reads 'that value is shown to the owner at HC-1 (N10) and recorded here only then', which cannot be executed as written: edge E-06-10 is HARD, so N10 MAY NOT BEGIN until N06's exit condition is satisfied, and that exit condition requires all seven pre-mint fields — this one included — to be present. A field first recorded at N10 could never have been present at N06. The correct sequence is: N09 computes the instant, N06 RECORDS it here, and only then does N10 STATE the already-recorded value to the owner as HC1-S4. HC-1 states this record; it does not create it.

planned_removal_date_owner_input_receive.owner_constraint_supplied_with_it: planned_removal_date is independent of expiry_exact_utc and is never set equal to it by assumption. If N09 computes an expiry EARLIER than the planned removal, expiry is the hard outer bound and the removal must occur no later than the expiry.

entries.planned_removal_date_WHO_PRODUCES_IT: CORRECTED by the CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CONSOLIDATED-CLOSURE-AW-R1 lane. This field previously carried the hole reason 'Tied to the same unsupplied FINAL WITNESS timestamp that blocks expiry_exact_utc', and the governing authority gave it closure_path 'Same as expiry_exact_utc'. That closure path resolves to DAG node N09, whose act computes planned FINAL WITNESS + 24 hours — the VALID UNTIL, a different quantity. The field was attributed to a node that computes another value, and independent certification found it had NO PRODUCER NODE anywhere in the certified graph. N31 is that producer.
entries.planned_removal_date_CLASSIFICATION: HUMAN_SUPPLIED_EXECUTION_DATUM, not a mechanically derived schedule datum. The POLICY is already ratified at OD-1 (post-FINAL-WITNESS removal is MANDATORY) and is not reopened; what is missing is only the concrete planned instant implementing it. No ratified clause fixes an interval from the witness to the removal, so no derivation exists to perform.
entries.planned_removal_date_IS_NOT_EQUAL_TO_exp: NOT ASSERTED AND NOT ASSUMED. The two are distinct fields with distinct meanings: expiry_exact_utc is when the credential STOPS WORKING BY ITSELF under a hosted VALID UNTIL; planned_removal_date is when custody is planned to END BY AN ACT, the mandatory post-witness rotation and its removal verification. No controlling authority requires equality. The one bound that IS derivable and binding is that the removal is not planned earlier than the planned FINAL WITNESS instant (OD-1, 'rotation after the FINAL WITNESS'). Whether it must also fall at or before expiry_exact_utc is an OPEN OWNER INPUT and is not settled by inference.
entries.planned_removal_date_WHEN_IT_IS_RECORDED: AT DAG NODE N06, STRICTLY BEFORE N10, for the same E-06-10 HARD-ordering reason stated for expiry_exact_utc above. HC1-S6 ('when it will be removed') STATES this record to the owner; it does not create it.
